description.text: In the 26 years since our founding, we have worked with hundreds of extraordinary European founders, and have raised more than $5.7bn across 12 funds.

targetApplicants.text: We care about and support founders as people — not just CEOs or business leaders. Because building a successful company requires more than performance at work.
